headline: Microsoft Solitaire
title: Windows Solitaire Facts | Made by an Intern | Classic Games
video_script: Microsoft Solitaire came with Windows three point zero in nineteen ninety. It was programmed by a Microsoft intern named Wes Cherry in the summer of nineteen eighty eight, and the cards were designed by Susan Kare. Microsoft included it partly to help people get used to the mouse, because moving cards teaches drag and drop. In twenty nineteen it was inducted into the World Video Game Hall of Fame. Did you play it on your school computer? Comment below!

scenes.sub: World Video Game Hall of Fame, 2019

description: Microsoft Solitaire shipped with Windows 3.0 in 1990, programmed by intern Wes Cherry with cards by Susan Kare, and entered the World Video Game Hall of Fame in 2019. Sources: Wikipedia, The Strong National Museum of Play.
joke: Solitaire taught millions to use a mouse, and also taught them to look busy at work.
